currentCommitSourceAudit.scope: Production src/** write/change sinks and selected call paths, plus a narrow review of the resource-budget evidence writer; excludes complete tests/build/tools/installer/external command audit, host preflight, and independent runtime write monitor.

findings.summary: Same-directory create-new temporary, atomic replace, and backup generation are used through Agent settings services. Product directory identity, ACL, and race/reparse resistance are not pinned or proven at write time.
New product folder uses a schema marker and checks unknown entries/reparse points before append+flush. Marker is forgeable and the append path is not handle-pinned after checks.
Create-new temporary and overwrite publication are below a marked ProgramData product path. Marker is forgeable and check/write and overwrite target identity are not handle-pinned.

Owned-root validation gates segment/index write and recovery paths, but configurable history root, marker authenticity, directory identity, race resistance, and SQLite/staging destructive recovery boundaries are not fully proven. Segment history deletion is not an authorized sink.

Media operations use volume-bound handle-relative sessions, pinned root, create-new files, and no-replace publication. Plain JSON ownership marker is forgeable; ancestor DELETE_CHILD/ACL and non-NTFS/removable filesystem semantics remain unproven. MediaImport publishes local ledger generations with overwrite=false.

ChangeServiceConfig2 is reachable via exact command-line option, called by deferred non-impersonated MSI action after service start. Source has no UAC prompt; dedicated-PC pre-presentation/UAC gate and end-to-end installer audit remain unverified.

Commits ddc293d and 3509fde require a canonical run GUID, an existing marker-only root with matching run/role/volume GUID/label/filesystem and no reparse points, use create-new for files and a direct run-named oracle, and verify exact known tree contents before recursive delete. Architecture source-contract tests and the full fast suite pass. Residual path-based check/use races and root/volume ownership-marker authenticity remain unproven; do not execute before the complete Requirement 37 audit and independent runtime gates.

Commit 3509fde rejects volume roots, protected/synchronized descendants, reparse paths, any fixture-root entry except the two expected run-bound markers, and marker/live-volume identity, label, and filesystem mismatches; it accepts verified local drive and volume-GUID roots. Marker JSON remains forgeable and validation is path-based with TOCTOU; no privileged lane test ran. Blocking pending race/ownership closure and full Requirement 37 review.

Commit 473834b checks generated SMB/service names are absent before creation, records successful creation, and only cleans up when the current share path or service executable still matches the run-owned target. InstallerManifestTests statically assert these guards; the Windows integration project builds with zero warnings/errors and Fast passed 345/345. The privileged tests were not executed; hostile races and all other destructive paths remain outside this narrow result.

Commit e0529db replaces the legacy VDI deletion helper with an unconditional no-I/O fail-closed stub. PowerShell AST review confirms only Write-Error executes. Future file-backed VHDX creation/cleanup remains a separate, gated workflow.

Commit 1e8f97d replaces the legacy VirtualBox VDI creation/attachment helper with an unconditional no-I/O fail-closed stub. Its source-contract test requires the retirement notice and absence of helper imports, VBoxManage invocation, filesystem creation/deletion, and evidence writes. PowerShell parser validation is non-executing; targeted test and the 339-test fast suite pass with zero build warnings. This does not approve the separate file-backed VHDX physical workflow.

Commit 3509fde adds a case/PC/run-bound phrase presented by the parent; the driver also displays it and requires an exact Console.ReadLine match before its mutation switch. The driver nevertheless requires an already elevated process; there is no operation-bound UAC prompt after the specific action is presented. A direct caller can supply the receipt/nonce and bypass the parent's externally reviewed hash-manifest check, and verified MSI paths are reopened later by msiexec. No direct-driver negative-path or MSI test ran.

The Explorer scenario producer now checks both markers against the live fixed-NTFS volume identity, rejects reparse paths, requires an existing in-root output parent, and uses exclusive CreateNew outputs/files; parser, source-contract, DocMirror, and the 338-test fast suite pass with no build warnings. Not executed on a physical volume; marker authenticity and path-based TOCTOU remain. Other evidence/build/package sinks still require full call-chain inventory and new-only/approved-root confinement.

Commit 444565d separates the ResourceMonitor raw samples from the queue-augmented final report, and both JSON artifacts are create-only; the PID list is also kept as an array for the single-process case. Script AST parsing, DocMirror, static contract tests, and Fast passed. A one-second diagnostic sampled only the current shell and confirmed distinct raw/final files with matching process ID and sample count; diagnostic mode is explicitly ineligible and is not the independent, application-attributed write monitor or formal 600-second acceptance.

acceptanceScriptAudit.scope: Static review of selected build/**, tools/**, installer/** sinks and call paths; not exhaustive.
findings: The file-mutation workload overwrite finding is narrowed by commit ddc293d: run GUID, marker-only root, no-reparse checks, create-new paths, run-bound in-root oracle, and exact deletion-tree checks are implemented and fast tests pass. Path-based TOCTOU and marker authenticity remain open, so workload execution remains gated.
Commit 3509fde adds marker-only fixture-root and live volume-identity checks in the privileged runner. The marker is still forgeable and the path-based check/use race is not closed.

Commit 3509fde adds per-case user prompting in the parent installer harness and a driver-side case/PC/run phrase plus standard-input gate. The receipt/nonce/input remain caller-supplied and direct-driver negative-path execution has not been tested.

Commit 473834b hardens privileged SMB/service test cleanup: collision checks precede creation, cleanup requires a successful create in this invocation, and the live share path/service executable is rechecked before removal. The project builds and the non-privileged static contract test passes; no privileged lane was run.

The physical installer case driver still requires an already elevated process and does not itself validate the externally approved hash-manifest fingerprint; msiexec reopens the path after hash checks. Operation-bound UAC sequencing and hash-to-use binding remain blockers.

The old VirtualBox VDI cleanup sink was retired by commit e0529db; the old VDI creation/attachment helper is now also a no-I/O stub with a source-contract test. The old guest runner was reduced to a no-I/O stub by commit ddc293d. This does not authorize the separately gated file-backed VHDX physical workflow or close other runner risks.

The Explorer scenario producer no longer uses overwrite-capable output paths, but several other evidence and build/package producers may still overwrite existing paths; full sink inventory and approved-root/new-only policy remain open.

Commit 444565d separates raw ResourceMonitor evidence from queue-augmented output and uses create-only publication for both. A diagnostic shell-process sample verified preservation only; it does not satisfy the independent runtime write-monitor or formal resource gate.

findings.summary: Creation requires a new GUID-named VHDX, explicit confirmation, a local fixed NTFS root with 40 GiB free, and no reparse ancestors. Before storage mutations, the exact attached image and its unique-ID disk lookup are re-resolved and matched to the same file-backed disk. System/Boot/pagefile/crash-dump roles are checked before state changes and initialization; RAW style and no-partition conditions are required. The unique partition and volume are rechecked immediately before formatting, and the resulting Volume GUID is recorded. After any create attempt the exact image is detached and verified; unverifiable detach fails acceptance. No automatic deletion occurs. DiskPart create/attach and filesystem TOCTOU/OS effects, direct API behavior on Windows 10 22H2, independent write monitoring, and ownership-verified destroy remain unverified.

Runner requires a new explicit local NTFS evidence root outside the repository and rejects UNC, OneDrive/Documents, Windows, Program Files (x64/x86), ProgramData, and existing roots. A static source-contract test covers protected-root rejection. Checks remain path-based; approved-root consent, hostile-race resistance, real-host resolution, and independent runtime monitoring remain unverified. No privileged lane ran.

The physical launcher and Test-Installer parent require an externally reviewed hash-manifest fingerprint and verify selected MSI/driver correspondence; matching Workload/NTFS markers and volume identity, fixture roots outside protected/system/repository/bundle/synchronized roots, canonical Program Files/ProgramData install/history paths, a clean product/service/install/ProgramData boundary, dedicated-PC/run confirmation, run-owned receipt, and one-case nonce are also enforced. The lower-level case driver only checks MSI hashes against the caller-supplied receipt and does not independently verify the external fingerprint; direct invocation therefore bypasses the parent's trust anchor. MSI paths are reopened after verification without an identity-pinned handle. Operation-bound UAC, full source-to-sink and installed-state discovery across profiles, trusted release signing, race/TOCTOU proof, independent runtime monitoring, and physical hardware proof remain. Runtime is NOT_EXECUTED; DO_NOT_RUN.
Product uninstall and VHDX removal are now rejected without performing changes. Exact run-ownership cleanup remains unimplemented.

findings.scope: Static source review of NtfsApi.OpenVolume and query/read/enumerate call paths only
findings.summary: Uses GENERIC_READ and OPEN_EXISTING; no journal creation/resizing call was found in reviewed call paths. Does not prove device identity, other collectors, or runtime effects.

findings.scope: Static source review of reviewed WindowsNativeApi open/read paths only
findings.summary: Uses existing directory-list/read-attributes handles. Does not prove absence of OS last-access effects or path-swap races.

Working tree rejects UNC and lexical overlap with MonitoringPaths; storage engine also requires owned/new-empty root and rejects reparse/unknown entries before recovery. 17 Settings and 12 Storage tests passed. Mapped/network identity, runtime TOCTOU, and pre-marker history migration remain unverified.

WindowsNativeApi queries MSFT_Partition read-only and the pure classifier fails closed for missing/ambiguous/unknown data; deterministic role cases are covered, but live WMI remains unverified. IsVolumeIdentityBound was removed. ExternalMediaStore, collector, import, and recovery require the volume-bound filesystem contract; Windows production I/O uses verified handles, create-only file creation, and session-issued no-replace publication. Existing unmarked roots and unknown root/writer entries fail closed. Focused fixture tests: Windows filesystem 21 passed; ExternalMedia 20 passed. Independent review confirms publication-stream reuse is closed and identified the disposal-registration race, now addressed by session-lock serialization but pending rebuild/retest. Plain JSON marker authenticity remains forgeable, and ancestor DELETE_CHILD resistance is unproven. Physical/runtime identity validation has not run.

Only GUID-named segment temps are considered recoverable; unknown and invalid/partial temps are retained and fail closed, while complete temps are finalized without overwrite. Root/writer markers gate writes and import reads. ExternalMedia tests passed 20/20; physical ownership attestation remains unverified.

Relocation now refuses existing destinations and establishes an owned staging root; recovery runs only after owned-root/entry validation. Targeted Storage tests pass. Mapped-volume identity and runtime TOCTOU remain unverified.

Read-only importer stores validate root and writer ownership markers, reparse points, and recognized entries before reading; missing roots remain a read-only no-op. Regression test confirms an unmarked existing directory and its bytes remain unchanged. ExternalMedia tests: 19 passed.

Incomplete .open tails are no longer truncated. Complete prefix records remain readable; damaged segments are excluded from append, and new records use a new segment. Regression test verifies byte-for-byte preservation and new-segment creation. Storage tests passed 12/12.

Ledger reads/writes require a marked owned directory; unowned paths, reparse points, and unexpected entries fail closed. Corrupt bytes are retained and import stops; unique create-new temps are used and prior hash sets cannot be dropped. ExternalMedia tests verify byte preservation and unowned directory refusal. Cross-process concurrency and physical fault injection remain unverified.

Role classification logic is implemented and deterministically tested, but the actual Windows WMI query has not run on a supported host. The caller-settable identity boolean and path-based store I/O have been removed; a handle-bound session is wired through Store, collection, recovery, and import. A verified product root is pinned and no-replace publication is tested on local fixtures. Independent review found forgeable marker authenticity and unproven resistance to ancestor DELETE_CHILD operations. Live volume-role evidence, physical runtime monitoring, and end-to-end physical media acceptance remain NOT_EXECUTED.
Compression temps and manifests use create-new; finalized compressed segments are published without overwrite. Targeted Storage tests pass; physical crash/fault injection remains NOT_EXECUTED.
SetFileInformationByHandle applies I/O priority metadata to candidate handles; ETW trace and service recovery configuration have not been covered by runtime side-effect audit.
Full source-to-sink review of collector, P/Invoke, service, IPC and OS command paths is incomplete.
Canonical-path/reparse/volume isolation and all storage configuration call sites have not been proven.
No independent process-attributed runtime write monitor or before/after inventory has run.
